decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extensions are used.

Condition : 4 - It is considered that this application for the erection of  a  proposed porch, insertion of a new window and part flank extension to this dwellinghouse, because of its position, design and appearance, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of number 7 College Road and is complimentary to the visual amenity of the locality and would not be detrimental to the amenities of adjoining and neighbouring properties and would serve to preserve the character of the Conservation Area.  The development is in accordance with Policies ENV-B 1.1 (New Development) ENV B 2.2 (Conservation Areas) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.
description: Erection of a single storey front / side extension to existing dwellinghouse
